lines.en: I glide along the fallen branch.

lines.zh: 身体贴着地，像一道影子
lines.en: My body hugs the ground like a shadow.
My scales brush the leaves softly.
I curve around to avoid the water.

lines.zh: 丛林里的湿度我很喜欢
lines.en: I like the damp of the jungle.

lines.zh: 我抬高前半身，越过树根
lines.en: I lift my front half over a root.

lines.zh: 每到一处，我都先试风向
lines.en: I test the wind at every stop.
I follow the tracks on the ground.

lines.zh: 背上的菱纹在光里发亮
lines.en: The diamonds on my back shine in the light.
Slowly, one coil after another.

lines.zh: 落叶层很厚，我几乎无声
lines.en: The leaf litter is thick; I am nearly silent.
I stop at the edge of the shade.
I coil, my head in the center.

lines.zh: 舌头一伸一缩，在尝空气
lines.en: My tongue flicks out, tasting the air.
I am still, but always awake.
The canopy is dripping.
I wait for one careless footstep.
This forest carries my scent.
I turn my head slowly toward warmth.
It is a little cool under my scales.

lines.zh: 呼吸很慢，几乎看不出来
lines.en: My breathing is so slow it is invisible.

lines.zh: 我在听落叶下面的动静
lines.en: I listen under the leaf litter.

lines.zh: 尾巴的末端轻轻敲了一下
lines.en: My tail tip taps once.
I need not chase; I only wait.
The sun slants in; I do not move.
Deer on the air, far off.

lines.zh: 我抬起头，差不多到你的膝
lines.en: I raise my head to about your knee.
My head is behind the root.
You walk so loudly.

lines.zh: 我吐了吐信子，量你的形状
lines.en: I flick my tongue and measure your shape.
Are you watching the ground?
I know that kind of sole.
You have stepped into my range.
My eyes do not blink.
If you back away, I will not chase.

lines.zh: 我身长比你以为的更长
lines.en: I am longer than you think.
That stick in your hand.
I do not like being stepped on.
I raise my head a little higher.

lines.zh: 你的影子落在我的身上
lines.en: Your shadow falls across me.
Let us simply look at each other.
Did you hear the leaves move?

lines.zh: 我是丛林里最长的那条
lines.en: I am the longest one in this jungle.
Do not kick the leaf litter.
I snap into a tight coil.
One patch of scales goes pale.
That made me draw back.
My tail taps the ground in agitation.
I hiss once.
Not much blood comes out.
I pull myself tighter.
I can still move.
Where you stepped still hurts.

lines.zh: 那块东西在动，我看见了
lines.en: That morsel is moving; I see it.
You hold it too far away.
Put it on the ground, not with your hand.
I am hungry, but patient.
The smell will do.
That will not fill my jaws.

lines.zh: 你把食物和你的手靠近了
lines.en: You have brought the food and your hand close together.
I circle half around and look again.
Kicked, I coil tight at once.

lines.zh: 我的身体被你踩住一段
lines.en: You stepped on part of me.
I whip my tail into the leaves.
That made me pull my head back.
I slide against your ankle.
My scales are slick; you cannot pin me.
My whole body goes taut.
Do not step back; you will tread on me.
We collide, and I give way.

lines.zh: 我沿着你的腿绕了半圈
lines.en: I loop half around your leg.
Between our kind, we circle first.
I am a little longer than she is.
The deep jungle is quiet.
We coil in the same patch of shade.
No need to fight; there is room.
One touch of tails and it is understood.
I do not bite my own kind.
All these trails are ours.
Slowly; do not startle the prey.
I follow her.
I take it in my jaws to test.
Not meat; I spit it out.

lines.zh: 我用吻部顶开这枚硬物。
lines.en: I nudge this hard thing aside with my snout.
I nudge it and it rolls away.

lines.zh: 丛林蝮的牙，留在我嘴里更合适。
lines.en: Bushmaster fangs belong in my jaw.
This tastes of copper.
I press it under the leaves.
I go around it, ignoring it.
Who dropped this here?
I have the heat source fixed.
You should not have stopped.
I am downwind of you.
This strike will be quick.
I am coiled and ready.
Your ankle is exposed.
I need not hiss.
When the leaves move, you should go.
This scent goes into my tongue.
You are exactly what I wait for.
My front half is rising.
Half a body length is all I need.
I am patient; my aim is exact.
Hold still and you last a little longer.
I begin.
I track you along the leaf litter.
Your footprints are fresh.
I can follow without eyes.
I am under the roots.

lines.zh: 你每走一步，我就近一寸
lines.en: Each step you take, I gain an inch.
I move downwind of you.
My body is beneath the leaves.
I wait for you to step onto me.

lines.zh: 前面的路上有一片阴影
lines.en: There is a shadow on the path ahead.
My head stays against the ground.

lines.zh: 你越快，留下的味道越重
lines.en: The faster you go, the more scent you leave.
I dislike long chases.
I know this forest better than anyone.
You have reached the clearing.
There is no cover there.
I am just behind your feet.
Three more steps.
I lunge, front half first, and bite.
My fangs are long and sink deep.
I bite and pull back.
The venom lies at the fang root, not the tip.
The bite will go numb.
My head turns to a new angle.
This bite hit your armor.
I retract and coil again.
Leaves scatter from my strike.
That only grazed skin.

lines.zh: 我吐着信子看你的反应
lines.en: I flick my tongue, watching your reaction.
You retreat; I follow in.
My body is still drawing tight.

lines.zh: 这一击我用了大半身长
lines.en: That strike used most of my length.
You did not fall; that surprises me.
Something stirs under the leaf litter.
I raise my head between the roots.
The damp of the forest suits me.
First I coil myself.
The smell here is unfamiliar.
My shadow is a man's length long.
The rain just stopped; water everywhere.
I glide up onto the fallen log.
The birds far off suddenly go quiet.
This patch of shade is mine.
I am well hidden.
Leaves drip overhead.

lines.zh: 我在等一个合适的位置
lines.en: I am waiting for a good position.
The canopy is thick; little light gets through.
I poke my head out of the brush.
The ground is wet mud, very slick.

lines.zh: 我已经在这里一会儿了
lines.en: I have been here a while already.

lines.zh: 火燎过我的鳞，卷了起来
lines.en: Fire scorches my scales and they curl.

lines.zh: 我从枝上掉下来，摔在根上
lines.en: I drop from the branch onto a root.

lines.zh: 我在水里挣扎，鳞片发冷
lines.en: I struggle in the water, scales cold.
The blast throws me clear of the roots.
An arrow pins through my back.

lines.zh: 那力量顺着鳞片钻进来
lines.en: That force seeps in along my scales.
Too long hungry; I move slower.
Lightning strikes and I go rigid.
No leaves here to press against.
